title: Bitrix24 Review (2026)
intro: Free-tier all-in-one CRM and collaboration suite with organization-based paid cloud plans. This review covers verified 2026 pricing, core CRM capabilities, limitations, and who should buy — based on official first-party sources.
summary: Bitrix24 scores reflect first-party research — not hands-on product testing.
verdict: Bitrix24 is compelling when you want free-start CRM plus collaboration in one org-priced suite. Expect more admin surface than Pipedrive-class tools. Based on first-party research — not hands-on testing.

criterionAssessments.rationale: All-in-one breadth is powerful but denser than focused pipeline CRMs; learning curve for CRM-only buyers.
CRM pipelines are included across the suite story.
Automation exists within the broader Bitrix24 toolkit.
Email/CRM tools present; specialists still lead dedicated engagement.
Adequate for many SMBs; not an enterprise analytics showcase.
Wide configurability across CRM, tasks, and collaboration modules.
Marketplace and connectors available; UX varies by region/deployment.
Org-wide suite admin (CRM + collab + tasks) raises overhead vs single-purpose CRM.
Org-based cloud plans and Enterprise path support growing companies.
Free tier plus org-priced cloud plans can be excellent value versus per-seat CRM stacks.

bestFor: Teams comparing org pricing vs per-seat CRM
notIdealFor: Enterprise Salesforce competitors needing deep SFA specialization
pros: Org-based pricing can beat per-seat stacks
pricingSummary: Free (1–2 users). EUR org/mo cloud: Basic ~€49/€69, Standard €99/€144, Professional €199/€289 (annual/monthly). Enterprise higher. Not per-user.
limitations: Confirm live Bitrix24 checkout; packaging can change.
whoShouldChoose: Choose Bitrix24 when it matches your CRM buying criteria above.
whoShouldConsiderAlternatives: Consider alternatives like hubspot, zoho-crm, pipedrive if fit is weak.
